No View Is the Whole

A Second-Order Philosophy of Understanding, Action, and Revision

Soman Lin

A computer alarm appears as Eagle descends towards the Moon. The crew needs a decision before anyone has a complete explanation. Everyday life poses quieter versions of the same difficulty: how can we act, predict, and understand ourselves while our knowledge remains unfinished?

This book introduces a second-order framework through three relations: preservation, composition, and return. It follows how understanding forms, connects with other understanding, and revises its own methods. Its concern is what this enables us to do, under which conditions, and at whose expense.

Sixteen chapters in five parts, seventeen images, and eighty-two source notes. Complete Chinese and English editions, switchable inside the reader.

所見非全貌

理解、行動與修正的二階哲學

Soman Lin

鷹號正向月面下降，導引電腦卻亮起警報。原因尚未查清，太空人已需要一個決定。日常生活也有這樣的難題：理解還不完整，我們仍須預測環境、認識自己，並採取行動。

本書從「保留、組合、回返」三種關係提出一套二階框架，追查理解如何形成、如何接上其他理解，又如何修正自身的方法。它關心理解有什麼用，也追問對誰有用、依靠哪些條件，以及代價由誰承擔。

全書十六章分成五部，十七張圖、八十二項來源註釋。中英文全文可在閱讀器內切換。
